description: Dynamically set the active project path for the current session. Call this at the start of a session to switch between projects without restarting the server or modifying environment variables. All subsequent tool calls will use this path as the default.

path.description: Absolute path to the project directory. Must be an existing directory.

validatePath.description: Whether to validate that the path exists and is a directory (default: true)

name: set_project_path
